stories.title: Spring Lake Park mayoral race flips again after recount
stories.summary: The race initially ended in a 1,401 to 1,401 tie, prompting the city to hold a random drawing last week to determine the winner.

stories.title: Churches want more documents released after they say the federal government surveilled them
stories.summary: A civil rights attorney representing the churches said there was no foundation for the surveillance.

stories.title: Man accused of attacking Somali American Uber driver out on bond
stories.summary: Samit Patel posted an $800,000 conditional bond that will include monitoring, according to jail documents.

stories.title: Lockdown lifted at St. Francis Middle School, one parent briefly detained
stories.summary: The school was locked down after officials said an anonymous caller caused a safety concern.

stories.title: St. Paul City Council confirms Jeramiah Melquist as fire chief
stories.summary: Melquist has served as the department's assistant chief of operations since 2023, and will now take over the only ISO Class 1 fire department in the state.

stories.title: The Bond Between getting ready for Give to the Max
stories.summary: Rachel Mairose from The Bond Between joined KARE 11 News at 4 to show off some puppies.

stories.title: Beltrami County authorities say man last seen in January has been found deceased
stories.summary: Corey Bryant was last seen north of Bemidji on Jan. 26.

stories.title: Little Rebels shares easy meals for kids
stories.summary: The sauce options include Roasted Veggie Marinara, Cheesy Butternut Squash and Lil' Green.

stories.title: 12-year-old sells his toys so mom in car crash can pay bills
stories.summary: AJ Enfield set up an online auction to sell his toys after his mother was injured in a car accident.

stories.title: Man fatally shot by St. Louis County deputy in Hibbing after law enforcement said he picked up gun
stories.summary: The St. Louis County Sheriff's Office said a deputy fired after the man allegedly shoved a Chisholm police officer and picked up a long gun.

stories.title: State investigation finds Bemidji School District failed to protect students from sexual harassment
stories.summary: Students as young as kindergarten were sexually harassed, according to the Minnesota Department of Human Rights.

stories.title: Challenger claims win in Spring Lake Park mayoral race, saying recount flipped results
stories.summary: The city made national news after determining a winner by pulling a name out of a bag.
